method: 72 radial rays in the plane normal to the registered course, at 30%, 50% and 70% of its length. Chords join opposite rays. Missing rays and open fissures are not valid diameter measurements. Saved v143 sampling includes both maxillary alveolar process meshes. Historical v142 sampling excluded those separate alveolar nodes and used the original polyline rather than the smooth facial axis; therefore not every before/after row is directly comparable.
